designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge to protect nesting sea turtles, two years after Congress authorized it.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973 (16 U.S.C. 1534) and Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 (16 U.S.C. 742f); authorized by Congress in 1989

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, Archie Carr NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan: "authorized by Congress in 1989 and established in 1991" under the Endangered Species Act and Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956

review.note: Authorized by Congress 1989, established 1991 by acquisition (CCP). Exact date not found.
